title: Wayfinding map
description: The shared map `wayfind` charts for an effort too large for one session: five sections and the ticket set. The map is an index, not a store. A decision lives in its ticket (`schemas/ticket.schema.json`, `type: decision`), which also carries its subtype and its blocking edges, and the map gists it and links by ticket id, so a ticket can be claimed, resolved and closed without the map restating it. The ids are links rather than hash-bound references because a ticket changes as it is worked and the map would go stale on every claim. A map written to an external tracker takes that tracker's form; this schema is the form published through the knowledgebase adapter's `publishArtifact` under a `run-artifact` placement, never a path in the working repository (ruling `central-kb-owns-project-artifacts`).

status.description: 'open' while anything is left to decide; 'complete' when the way to the destination is clear. Which tickets are still on the frontier is a fact about the tickets, not the map, so this schema holds only the half it can see: a complete map has nothing left in Not yet specified.

destination.description: The specification, decision or change the effort is finding its way to, as one sentence a reader could hold the whole effort against. Settled first, because it fixes the scope.

notes.description: Orientation a session needs before choosing a ticket.

decisions_so_far.description: One line per resolved ticket: the gist and the link, referred to by name. Empty at charting.

not_yet_specified.description: Fog that cannot yet be phrased as a sharp question. A patch graduates into tickets when the frontier reaches it and is cleared from here, so it lives in one place only.

out_of_scope.description: Work ruled past the destination. Each entry carries its gist and the reason, and links the closed ticket where one existed. Out-of-scope work never graduates; it returns only if the destination is redrawn, and then as a fresh effort.

tickets.description: The ticket set, by id (shape `map-<effort>-<question>`). Every ticket this skill cuts is a decision ticket; implementation tickets that later hang off these decisions come from `super-bound` and are not listed here.

allOf.description: A complete map has no fog left in it.
